name: Fire Keeper of the Ashened City
desc: If "Obsidim, the Ashened City" is in the Field Zone, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Fire Keeper of the Ashened City" once per turn this way. You can discard this card (Quick Effect): Place 1 "Obsidim, the Ashened City" from your Deck or GY, face-up in either Field Zone, or if there is "Obsidim, the Ashened City" on the field, you can add 1 "Ashened" or "Veidos" card from your Deck, GY or banishment to your hand. If a card is destroyed while this card is in the GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Fire Keeper of the Ashened City" once per turn.
strings: Add this card from GY to hand
Place "Obsidim, the Ashened City" in a Field Zone
Place it in your Field Zone
Place it in your opponent's Field Zone
